title: Prove exact BW16 clique insertion barriers (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove exact local insertion barriers around DaysSky's published BW16 72-line clique. This is an **exact finite certificate and scoped combinatorial proof**, with no new kappa.

```text
one outside line              -> at least 20 old deletions, attained
two compatible outside lines -> at least 30 old deletions, attained
retain at least 43 old lines  -> no different clique of size 72 or larger
```

For exactly d old deletions and at least one outside insertion, no clique exists below d=20; the exact largest size is 73-d for 20<=d<=29. Thirty is a sharp two-line insertion threshold, not a proved sharp radius for an improving exchange. The attaining cliques have 53 and 44 lines. The predecessor's window floor remains 72.

Only `research/bw16-clique-exchange-barrier/` is added. The [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19142722) initially sought a larger clique. Two bounded heuristics found none; the [scope update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19142904) records the delivered local obstruction. The construction search stopped at this first new verified result. The result guides the next search beyond small replacements and makes no global maximum claim.

## Evidence

- **Before:** #895 supplies a 72-line witness and leaves larger cliques open.
  **After:** the new certificate excludes every improving replacement deleting at most 29 lines of that exact witness.
- All 2,088 outside lines and 2,178,828 unordered outside pairs are classified. The single-deletion histogram is `{20:378,29:1080,36:630}`. There are 1,316,988 compatible pairs; 11,340 attain deletion union 30. The complete pair histogram, attaining vectors and package hashes are generated on stdout.
- Standard-library CPython 3.12.15/macOS local replay passes with both signed-mask and literal integer-dot pair computations, each in normal and optimized Python. The four registered checks took 0.425, 0.426, 1.288 and 1.298 seconds in the recorded replay, below their 120-second limits.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight, official committed export and export integrity pass. All four modes also pass in a Git-free export with read-only files and `PATH=/nonexistent`; all eight exported files, including the export receipt, retain identical hashes. Three deliberate semantic mutations are rejected: intersection in place of union, omitted compatibility filtering and omitted inner-product scale.
- New code is bounded, read-only and has no imported predecessor executable, solver or recursion. Its fixed-domain Python allocation deviation is documented in the README. No mathematical result from another contributor is audited as the deliverable.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bw16-clique-exchange-barrier
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -B research/bw16-clique-exchange-barrier/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -W error -O -B research/bw16-clique-exchange-barrier/verify.py --literal
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bw16-clique-exchange-barrier --check-source-history
```

Expected markers are `PASS_BW16_CLIQUE_EXCHANGE_BARRIER one=20 two=30 outside=2088 compatible_pairs=1316988`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This is a finite neighborhood theorem about the exact fixed clique. It does not prove maximum clique, a stronger decoder-window floor, a complete paid supplier, physical/helper/restoration costs, compiler/outer admission or a multiplication theorem. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No registered local obligation remains unrun; no native, Lean, Docker, selected cold replay or historical suite was run.

The original card's historical orientation command `research/complex-local-word-ceiling/verify.py` raises `KeyError: 'complex_profile'` on the changed selected schema. That unrelated reporter is unchanged and is not evidence for this result. The current selected record and family guidance were read; this package changes neither.

Scientific base is canonical main `81e9bd69e4a5b00ba9c713a1620e36d576d5522e`, priority revision 7, unchanged at the submission refresh. Overlap coverage includes the complete cached snapshot of 321 open PRs and 4,236 Discussion records, refreshed live handoffs and object-specific all-state/merged PR searches, and main-tree README searches. Sparse local notes, arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhaustively covered. No overlapping successor was identified within that coverage.

## Open next questions

1. Find a larger clique through a move discarding at least 30 old lines or a different starting construction. Begin with at most 42 retained old lines. The necessary threshold is not asserted sufficient.
2. Explain the deletion spectrum structurally, beginning with the 378 minimum-deletion lines under the actual stabilizer, or test a different inequivalent clique. No orbit/equivalence classification is supplied.

## Related open work

- [#895](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/895), DaysSky, head `3bf6fccaf17521ffdb9b3bec2740ba4886478556`, studies the same BW16 shell and decoder window. Its 72-line clique is an unchanged attributed input; this package adds the insertion thresholds 20 and 30, without re-pricing or endorsing its screen. No competing numerical claim about these thresholds appears in that PR.

## Credit

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. DaysSky supplies the shell setting and published clique. Its exact JSON bytes are retained unchanged with source commit, path, SHA256 and notice; the pending source head is not a local Git object, so the package contains the authenticated exported input. DreamingOfClouds #446/#595/#2244, Joel Pulikkan #620, #598/#606 and the classical Barnes-Wall, Reed-Muller and Construction-D lineage retain their credit. New material is Apache-2.0.

## CI notes

**CI blocked upstream** at package head `bede750d1aaa0e47930a398d4779078f8107370d`. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39934127447/job/120349363378) failed in **Onboarding helper tests**: 408 tests ran in 140.809 seconds, with eight failures and seventeen skips. Package selection did not run and [replay was skipped](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39934127447/job/120350843886), so hosted CI has not certified this package. The previously recorded local package checks remain the available replay evidence.

The checkout log identifies synthetic merge `cfcc2e0130a605f694144e35a2fb5333353f055f`, merging this head into main base `20a1e31bc6009b9b3f4d084bbaadc6350e34fcba`. The eight failures are:

- In `tests/test_research_descendant_source_roles.py`, `test_historical_blob_and_hash_corruption_still_rejects` fails for both `git_blob` and `sha256`. It expects respectively `source blob provenance mismatch: scripts/research_package.py` and `source SHA256 provenance mismatch: scripts/research_package.py`.
- In the same module, `test_historical_history_test_pin_corruption_rejects` fails for both fields, expecting the corresponding `source blob provenance mismatch: tests/test_research_source_history.py` and `source SHA256 provenance mismatch: tests/test_research_source_history.py`.
- `test_live_history_guard_is_not_a_historical_source_substitution` expects return code zero and receives one.
- `test_original_gate_rejects_but_correct_role_accepts_current_helper` expects `working source drift: scripts/research_package.py`.
- `test_original_history_input_role_rejects_live_guard_successor` expects `working source drift: tests/test_research_source_history.py`.

All seven assertions above instead receive exactly `working source drift: scripts/check_research_commit.py`. The shared fixture uses `research/isolated-descendant-bytecode/SOURCES.json`, whose live pin for that script is SHA256 `ecf206a82bf1f4e748efb6cc639919582050d173b3537ec12f7265a4f7b55ead`; the actual script at the CI main base hashes to `28fed1e156fe8601633ed453f682a158cb15e94981e6c89ed96ae72ffc9d0c6f`. The unrelated live-input mismatch stops the fixture before its intended historical-source checks.

The eighth failure is `tests/test_research_onboarding.py::OverlapTests.test_report_survives_a_cp1252_stdout`. Its temporary repository copies only `scripts/find_overlap.py`; that script now executes `from research_package import git_source_env` at line 24 and fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'research_package'`, returning one instead of zero.

These are shared upstream fixture/dependency failures. [Commit 862ac2a0f](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/862ac2a0fecbf1c613f7f07957f8c17b4b319bf3), confirmed as an ancestor of the CI main base, changes `scripts/check_research_commit.py` and introduces the `find_overlap.py` import. The two failing test modules are byte-identical between this contribution's head and that CI base. This contribution changes only its seven new package files; it changes no shared script, test or pinned historical package. These conclusions were checked against source bytes and CI logs; the shared test suite was not rerun locally in this follow-up.

The independently inspected failed logs show exactly the same eight failure names, field variants and assertion/error texts on:

- [PR #5117](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5117), head `eb0c12811253174a6a7834c118e2cf827cc9b706`, [run 39933925464](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39933925464/job/120348692016): 408 tests, eight failures, seventeen skips; replay skipped.
- [PR #5116, “Implement complete owned query streams on selected signed records”](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5116), head `ee4bebf4bb1d441bbbcd43ff4bc2bcb2734a679e`, [run 39933826517](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39933826517/job/120348368324): 408 tests, eight failures, seventeen skips; replay skipped.

No package or shared-file repair is included, no new commit was made, and DONE is withheld pending successful hosted CI. Scratch evidence is retained.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Seven files in one new opt-in research package; no selected-frontier, shared-code or workflow change.
